reviews.author: Sajin Babu
reviews.title: x95 Golens product and service experience.
reviews.body: I bought an x95 model Golens smart door lock after a lot of research online and physically at outlets. I could find only this model that actually suited my door specs and the carpentry required for replacing the existing conventional lock. Product delivery: Well packed, neatly categorised and highly safe boxing. No surprises of missing components or parts. No complaints in product finishes and build quality. reviews.title: Exelent smart lock
reviews.body: use for the Golens Smart Lock X95: Title: Excellent product — 5 stars! I’m very impressed with the Golens Smart Lock X95. Installation was quick and simple, and the sleek design looks great on my door. It offers multiple access methods ( face camera fingerprint, keypad, app, and backup key), and all of them work reliably. The fingerprint reader is fast and accurate, the keypad is responsive, and the mobile app is easy to use with helpful real-time notifications and access logs.
